Front Desk1.0

MCP reference

Instructions

Use search_functions first.
Then describe_function <before> call_function.

Tools

search_functions

List modules or find functions.
Input schema 
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "module": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}

describe_function

Show how to call functions.
Input schema 
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "names": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "names"
  ]
}

default

default.get_health GET /healthread-only

GET /health -> ErrorResponse

default.get_health  GET /health
  returns ErrorResponse: {message string}
  see also: ErrorResponse

packages

Packages received at the front desk.

packages.delete_packages_by_id DELETE /packages/{id}destructive

DELETE /packages/{id}

packages.delete_packages_by_id  DELETE /packages/{id}
  args:
    id  integer  required

packages.get_package GET /packages/{id}read-only

Get one package. -> Package

packages.get_package  GET /packages/{id}
  Get one package.
  Includes the carrier.
  args:
    id  integer  required
  returns Package: {id integer, unit_id integer, status packages.Status, received_at string date-time, unit Unit}
  see also: Package, Unit, packages.Status

packages.list_packages GET /packagesread-only

List packages -> Package[]

packages.list_packages  GET /packages
  List packages
  args:
    limit   integer int32
    status  packages.Status  Only packages in this status
  returns Package[]
  see also: Package, packages.Status

packages.register_package POST /packages

Register a package at the front desk. -> Package

packages.register_package  POST /packages
  Register a package at the front desk.
  The resident is notified.
  args:
    unit_id  integer  required  Unit receiving the package
    carrier  string   enum: dhl|fedex|ups
    notes    string?
  returns Package: {id integer, unit_id integer, status packages.Status, received_at string date-time, unit Unit}
  see also: Package, RegisterPackageRequest, Unit, packages.Status

packages.update_package PATCH /packages/{id}deprecated

Update a package

packages.update_package  PATCH /packages/{id}  [deprecated]
  Update a package
  args:
    id    integer  required
    body  Package  required
  returns {ok boolean}
  see also: Package

units

units.set_notes PUT /units/{unit_id}/notes

Replace the notes of a unit -> units.Status

units.set_notes  PUT /units/{unit_id}/notes
  Replace the notes of a unit
  args:
    unit_id       integer   required
    X-Request-Id  string
    body          string[]
  returns units.Status: string enum: occupied|vacant
  see also: units.Status

units.summary compositeread-onlycomposite

Summarize a unit -> UnitSummary

units.summary  composite
  Summarize a unit
  Counts the packages of a unit.
  args:
    unit_id  integer  required  Unit to summarize
    days     integer
  returns UnitSummary: {packages integer, status string}
  see also: UnitSummary
